items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIII, List of Answers on Topics 24:1
items.html: The membrane of air [Kruma deAvira] is the aspect of the screen that separates between covered Hassadim and revealed Hassadim, which are called upper waters and lower waters, which in the Rosh is called the membrane of air, and it separates between the Galgalta, corrected in the Mem of Tzelem, namely in covered Hassadim, which are the upper waters, and between the air and the Mocha Stima'ah, corrected in the LTz of Tzelem, namely in revealed Hassadim, which are the lower waters. And likewise the Parsa in the body separates between the HGT to the Chazeh, which are the aspect of the Mem of Tzelem and covered Hassadim, and between the Chazeh and below, which are the aspect of the LTz of Tzelem and revealed Hassadim. And this operates in the Rosh and body of all the Partzufim. And the reason for the matter is, that since the Mem of Tzelem is the aspect of covered Hassadim, the force of the screen at the Peh of the upper one does not govern it, and does not diminish it at all, and therefore it is still considered as the measure of the upper one without any diminution, and is therefore called upper waters, for it is still considered the upper one. But the LTz of Tzelem, which are revealed Hassadim, namely that they need the illumination of Hochma, the screen of the upper one already governs them, which brings them out outside of its degree into the aspect of a lower one, and therefore they are called lower waters. And the force of the screen of the upper one itself is discerned as the firmament that separates between them, similar to the bent line in the Aleph, which separates, and divides between the upper Yod and the lower Yod. (Vol. 1, p. 327, Item 72).
